impl.imageAnchors: Deployed image vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:3dbe092e, gdn_linear_attn.py = 1211 lines (extracted via docker create + docker cp, no GPU; byte-identical to /tmp/fr13_imgcheck). in_proj_ba anchor = forward_cuda Qwen3-Next main path, lines 544-545: `            mixed_qkvz, _ = self.in_proj_qkvz(hidden_states)` / `            ba, _ = self.in_proj_ba(hidden_states)` (the LoRA path at 536-537 uses in_proj_qkv/in_proj_z, never in_proj_qkvz, so the 2-line needle is unique). out_proj anchor = forward_cuda line 595 `        output[:num_tokens], _ = self.out_proj(core_attn_out)` (also at forward_xpu line 680, unchanged); the FR12 patcher edit precedes the forward_cuda one with a gate_out capture, so the LUMO_FB out needle anchors on that FR12 capture+out_proj sequence => unique to forward_cuda.
impl.apiPorted: Ported to the IMAGE API (not lifted verbatim from the 1420-line stale snapshot). The image GDNAttentionMetadata (vllm/v1/attention/backends/gdn_attn.py, @dataclass) DOES expose every required attr: num_prefills, num_decodes, num_spec_decodes, num_actual_tokens, spec_query_start_loc (shape [num_spec_decodes+1]). In the pure-spec-decode case (num_prefills==0 and num_decodes==0) the builder sets spec_query_start_loc = query_start_loc[:num_spec_decodes+1] (gdn_attn.py:262), exactly what the pad block reads. No adaptation/derivation needed. I dropped the snapshot's diagnostic instrumentation (_lumo_fb_gdn_proj_os/_do/_summary tied to LUMO_FB_TENSOR_DEBUG) and replaced it with 3 clean module-scope helpers (_lumo_fb_proj_meta / _lumo_fb_proj_spans / _lumo_fb_proj_padded) inserted before the forward() dispatch. get_forward_context, os, torch all already available in the patched image. attn_metadata read as dict keyed by self.prefix (matches forward_cuda's own `assert isinstance(attn_metadata_raw, dict)`).
impl.gate: Gate = `_lumo_fb_proj_meta` returns None immediately unless os.environ.get("LUMO_FB_KERNEL_ROWS")=="1"; then `_lumo_fb_proj_spans` returns spans only if num_spec_decodes>1 AND num_prefills==0 AND num_decodes==0 AND spec_query_start_loc is not None. pad_rows = max(num_spec_decodes, int(os.environ.get("LUMO_FB_PROJ_PAD_ROWS","16"))); spans computed from spec_query_start_loc[:nspec+1]; row_len = max span length; pad group = pad_rows*row_len (only padded when pad_rows>num_spec_decodes). Both in_proj_ba and out_proj call sites wrapped in try/except => on any exception, stock fallback (`ba, _ = self.in_proj_ba(hidden_states)` / `output[:num_tokens], _ = self.out_proj(core_attn_out)`). out_proj padded for consistency (fp8 => likely no-op, harmless).
impl.losslessCPUCheck: PASS, max_abs = 0.000e+00. Synthetic CPU check (torch 2.4.1 CPU): bf16 nn.Linear stands in for in_proj_ba (no bias, modules_to_not_convert path); 5 sequences with mixed span widths [10,5,7,5,6] (the M=tree_n co-residency case, 33 real rows), row_len=10. Replicated _lumo_fb_proj_padded EXACTLY (zero buffer of pad_rows*row_len, copy real rows in, ONE proj() at pinned shape, gather real rows back). torch.equal(padded_real_rows, unpadded proj(hidden)) == True (bit-for-bit) at pad_rows=16 (deployed default, fixed M=160) AND pad_rows=32, plus the out_proj output-buffer scatter form. Holds because a GEMM row is W @ src[row], independent of the zero pad-rows which are dropped.

impl.notes: All 5 requirements done, no blocker. (1) Image extracted, exact anchors found. (2) Required API attrs all present on the image GDNAttentionMetadata - no missing attr, no derivation. (3) Gate + pad-rows + try/except applied to BOTH in_proj_ba and out_proj. (4) Default-OFF byte-identical proven. (5) Lossless-by-construction CPU check PASS max_abs=0.0. Two RUNTIME caveats for the GPU test (cannot verify on CPU, by design): (a) M-invariance across decode steps requires row_len (=max span = tree width) to be constant across steps - true for cat9's fixed tree topology, but if a future drafter varies tree_n the M shifts and the carrier could re-appear; (b) the pad GEMM must actually pin cuBLASLt to ONE Split-K - that is the GPU existence test (cat9 22 -> ~5 confirms; stays 22 => flag insufficient / H1 wrong, fall to the extended in_proj_ba re-run A/B per the BIND doc). The in_proj_ba pad is the load-bearing fix (bf16 carrier); out_proj is fp8 (M-invariant) so its pad is expected to be a no-op but is included for consistency and is lossless either way.
